note: Only Dillon-specific parcel layer found is 'Parcels - SC - Dillon County' on SCDOT's SC_Parcels MapServer/16; the server returns 'Token Required' for the service and layer, so it is not publicly queryable. Dillon County's own Think GIS viewer (dillonsc.wthgis.com) exposes no discoverable REST endpoint (/arcgis/rest/services, /server/rest/services and config.json all 404). County GIS page gives no service link. Other hits are paid commercial shapefile vendors, not county-published services.
